comments-rule.desc: Verifies that there are no comments in the code, except for: - comments that start with `not-obvious: ` or `TODO`; or - short trailing comments, up to a maximum length (configurable).
comments-rule.rationale: Instead of comments, we want to encourage having good module, type, and function/method names because they can make the code self-documenting. We want the code to "comment itself", as they say. However, comments about something obscure that's not very obvious from the code can (infrequently) be desired, and that is what `not-obvious` is for.
